sanskrit_verse: vikrīṇīte ya ātmānaṃ svatantraḥ san narādhamaḥ | sa jaghanyataras teṣāṃ naiva dāsyāt pramucyate ||
transliteration: vikrīṇīte ya ātmānaṃ svatantraḥ san narādhamaḥ | sa jaghanyataras teṣāṃ naiva dāsyāt pramucyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who sells himself, though free, being a base man, shall receive nothing in return and shall not be released.
jurisprudential_principles: Causation: Voluntary abdication of self-authority creates relational void
Capacity-based responsibility: One capable of freedom bears full consequence of its misuse
Restoration logic: Transaction lacking mutuality yields no enforceable claim
Consciousness alignment: Misalignment with svadharma nullifies legal recognition
executable_legal_axioms: IF (agent.is_svatantra == TRUE AND action.type == 'self-sale') THEN enforceability = FALSE
IF (person.status == 'naradhama' AND transaction.lacks_reciprocal_obligation == TRUE) THEN outcome.validity = NULL
IF (responsibility.assumed == FALSE AND capacity.present == TRUE) THEN liability.enforceable = FALSE
supreme_court_application: In matters involving voluntary servitude or self-alienation by a competent individual, the court must assess whether the act aligns with svadharma. If not, it lacks judicial cognizance and cannot be enforced, regardless of formal consent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana reveals that self-sale violates the foundational truth of atman's non-transferability. The sequential unfolding (anupurvasah) shows such acts lead to relational breakdown, not remediable harm. Responsibility lies in misusing autonomy; thus, restoration occurs through realignment, not compensation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svatantrya-pratisthapana process to restore self-sovereignty awareness
Activate dharmic counseling to realign consciousness with non-alienable self-nature
Nullify transaction records from legal effect while preserving data for consciousness-based review
Engage community witness protocols to reaffirm individual’s intrinsic freedom
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: where one surrenders his svatantra nature, no binding arises. Dharma is restored through consciousness reclamation. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
